title: Nền tảng 16 — Động từ hằng ngày (2)

words.example: My father works in a factory.
words.note: cũng là danh từ: go to work (đi làm).

words.example: We study English every day.
words.note: study nghiêng về học ở trường, có sách vở.

words.example: I help my mother at home.
words.note: help somebody (with something).

words.example: She buys bread every morning.
words.note: quá khứ bất quy tắc: bought.

words.example: They sell fruit at the market.
words.note: trái nghĩa với buy; quá khứ: sold.

words.example: He gives me a new book.
words.note: give somebody something = give something to somebody.

words.example: I take the bus to school.
words.note: trái nghĩa với give; quá khứ: took.

words.example: My mother makes very good soup.
words.note: make là tạo ra vật mới; quá khứ: made.

words.example: I do my homework after dinner.
words.note: do homework, do housework; không dùng make homework.

words.example: I want a glass of water.
words.note: want to + động từ: I want to go.

words.example: She likes cats and dogs.
words.note: like + V-ing: like reading.

words.example: I love my family very much.
words.note: mạnh hơn like.

words.example: We need more time.
words.note: need to + động từ: I need to study.

words.example: They have two small dogs.
words.note: ngôi he/she/it dùng has.

words.example: I know his name.
words.note: chữ k đầu câm, đọc là /nəʊ/.

words.example: I think this book is easy.
words.note: think about something: nghĩ về việc gì.

words.example: She says hello to me.
words.note: say something; không nói say me.

words.example: Please tell me your name.
words.note: tell somebody something; luôn có người nghe.

words.example: Students ask the teacher many questions.
words.note: ask for help: nhờ giúp đỡ.

words.example: He answers all the questions.
words.note: chữ w câm; cũng là danh từ: an answer.

words.example: We live in a small town.
words.note: live in + thành phố, live at + số nhà.

words.example: I learn new words every day.
words.note: learn là học được kiến thức mới, study là ngồi học.
